nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used to predict brain volumes from age and sex.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Normative models were estimated using gaussian process regression, yielding coherent measures of predictive confidence in addition to point estimates.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Voxel-based morphometry gray and white matter volumes plus FreeSurfer cortical thickness and surface area (pial area) measures.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We estimated a normative brain aging model by using gaussian process regression to predict regional gray and white matter volumes across the brain from age and sex using voxelbased morphometry-derived gray and white matter maps.; We repeated an identical normative modelling procedure but instead of VBM whiteand gray matter maps we utilized measures of cortical thickness and surface area.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Wolfers2018.pdf.md: Normative Modeling; yoi180064supp1_prod.pdf.md: Normative modelling on cortical thickness and surface area

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were used as predictors in the normative models.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: predict regional gray and white matter volumes across the brain from age and sex
